- .claude/scripts/claude_fix_claim.py, lines 68-71 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `claim_body()` hardcodes the `--kind hold` branch to render the hand-back-cap message, and the helper exposes no `--reason` argument.
  WHY: Every protected-path project that lands twin-first will post a claim whose body says the PR hit the hand-back cap, which is false for a twin-sync hold.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md, line 35 (and the parallel .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:35) | severity=low | confidence=3

  WHY: A stage following the command literally could post BLOCKED and ask before applying the override; a phase requiring a watched session but not using the documented phrase could fall through to the automatic default.
- agents.md, lines 1143-1150 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The sentence that the stage "stops only for the `[claude-twin-sync]` copy" elides the full phase work the stage still performs.
  WHY: A future operator auditing the project could misread the summary as the stage being idle or the phase work missing.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Edit the twins first: this change itself touches `.claude/commands/**`, so it lands through the sync it describes."
  Expected change site: workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md step 4 (or its twin in the consumer path) plus its sync to .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md via `[claude-twin-sync]`
  Evidence of absence: the root copy .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md IS updated to the same new content as the twin in the same PR (the diff shows both .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md with identical hunks), bypassing the `[claude-twin-sync]` copy that the new rule requires for any project that lands twin-first. The progress log notes "root copy synced in `[claude-twin-sync]` f60a3b1" but the PR diff for the project-integration (#5102's parent) edits the root copy directly. This is not a missing requirement (the rule is about future projects, and AD-3 chose to add new text next to the existing line to merge with #4785), so cite the deferral and skip the gap.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
